why is there direction FIX ON/OFF?
it should be simple as normal (down, left, right, up) nothing else.
waitframes of 4 in between (like a normal door or chest would be).
if it needs to stay open, use selfswitch on the bottom to on or off.
also set direction, you miss 8, so it misses a frame.
